extensions.name: Nimora Compact
extensions.description: A lightweight Nimora bundle with the core movie, TV, anime, sports and LayarKaca providers.
extensions.author: nimbusfvck
releaseNotes: Moved the LayarKaca catalog to the All category with separate Movies on LK21 and TV Series on LK21 sections; the TV section uses Series Unggulan.
Added PlayZTV as an independent live-event stream provider with fresh link and token resolution, so it can be enabled separately from other stream providers.
Changed the LayarKaca catalog to a compact Home shelf section so movie and TV catalogs remain visible together; the full catalog is still available through See more.

Added an independent LayarKaca catalog for films and series. LayarKaca catalog and stream providers can now be enabled separately, with catalog series retaining direct episode playback through LayarKaca streams.
Added Dramadev as a stream-only movie source for TMDB movies, with exact title matching and fresh HLS resolution while keeping Dracin catalog playback intact.
Curated UEFA Champions League and Premier League Shorts to the 20 newest playable items and added movie, TV and football tags for Shorts filtering.
Added paginated Dramaverse and Storyreel Shorts catalogs with per-item tags and episode playback through fresh HLS resolution.
Restored Hydrax quality variants from decoder responses and updated P2P Playcdn resolution for the current `/verify/{slug}` flow.
Made Hydrax start playback from the lowest validated quality by default while keeping the quality variants ordered from highest to lowest for manual selection.
Fixed LayarKaca TurboVIP resolution by retrying the parent watch page and capturing the nested EmTurbovid player before WebView timeout.
Exposed title logos for all TMDB Trending Movie and TV catalog items with bounded, memoized artwork lookups.
Curated Football to include Saudi Pro League and exclude UEFA Youth League.
Fixed football league icons by using FotMob's canonical league artwork and primary competition IDs, including Champions League.
Fixed Champions League fixtures disappearing when FotMob uses season-specific league IDs and primary competition IDs.
Fixed LayarKaca `/iframe3/` resolution by parsing the nested player after a browser/Cloudflare fetch, avoiding parent-page timeouts while preserving source and quality extraction.
Initial Nimora Compact bundle with the core catalog, playback, subtitle and LayarKaca providers.
